origin: Kather JN, Halama N, Marx A (2018), Zenodo
task: binary TUM (adenocarcinoma epithelium) vs non-TUM, class-balanced
model_selection: in-distribution validation only; no third site exists in this dataset, so the WILDS ood_val protocol used for Camelyon17 cannot be reproduced (see DESIGN_crc.md)

unlabeled.note: SSL pre-training pool. Normalised cohort ONLY -- the encoder never sees NONORM appearance, which would leak the primary test condition. Labels are discarded.

shift_nonorm.role: PRIMARY shift axis: stain/acquisition shift, tissue material held approximately constant

shift_external.role: SECONDARY axis: 50 patients, no patient overlap with the 100K set, but SAME NCT tissue bank -- patient-disjoint external cohort, NOT a second hospital
